app.name: Lingo
popup.sync.space: Sync space: {used} KB of {quota} KB used
wordlist.title: Word list
settings.title: Settings
settings.languages.lead: Lingo highlights pages written in your learning language and translates into your own language.
settings.languages.learningDesc: Pages and subtitles in this language get highlights.
settings.languages.nativeDesc: Meanings and translations are shown in this language.
settings.languages.uiDesc: Language of Lingo's own buttons and menus. More languages are planned.
settings.level.lead: Words you have never saved count as New unless they are among the most common words. Raise the number as your vocabulary grows.
settings.level.label: Treat the {count} most common {language} words as known
settings.level.note: Words you have saved always keep the status you gave them. You can also save every unsaved word on a page at once from the toolbar popup.
settings.highlighting.lead: Choose which kinds of words are highlighted on pages and in subtitles.
settings.highlighting.newDesc: Words you have not saved that are above your level.
settings.highlighting.learningDesc: Words and phrases you are studying. On by default.
settings.highlighting.knownDesc: Words you have marked as known.
settings.highlighting.endCard: Offer to save the rest when you finish
settings.highlighting.endCardDesc: When a video ends or you scroll to the end of an article, a card in the top-right corner lets you add every unsaved word to Learning or Known at once.
settings.dictionaries.lead: Links shown in the dictionary window. Each one opens in a new tab with the word filled in.
settings.ai.title: AI explanations inside the window
settings.ai.descBuiltIn: Uses {browser}'s built-in AI on your device, or your own API key.
settings.video.lead: Where Lingo shows the current subtitle line on YouTube and Netflix. You can also switch it under the video.
settings.video.inVideoDesc: Shown over the bottom of the video, like normal subtitles.
settings.video.belowVideoDesc: Shown in a larger box under the player, so nothing covers the picture.
settings.video.subtitleTranslationDesc: The line in your language below the current subtitle.
settings.video.transcriptTranslationDesc: The line in your language on each transcript card. Set separately from the subtitle.
settings.sites.lead: Where Lingo runs. You can also switch it off for one site from the toolbar popup.
settings.sites.youtubeDesc: Subtitle bar, transcript and dictionary window on video pages.
settings.sites.articlesDesc: Highlights and dictionary on pages written in your learning language.
settings.sites.invalid: Enter a site such as example.com
settings.sync.lead: Lingo has no server. Your words are kept in this browser and, if you like, synced through {syncName}.
settings.sync.switchDesc: Reaches your other devices when you are signed in to {browser} with sync on. Only each word and its status are synced; sources and sentences stay on this device.
settings.backup.title: Backup file
settings.backup.desc: Everything, including sources and sentences, in one JSON file.
settings.cloud.title: Your own cloud storage
settings.cloud.desc: Sync everything through Google Drive, Dropbox, OneDrive, a folder on this computer or WebDAV, for when {syncName} space runs out.
settings.cloud.descNoFolder: Sync everything through Google Drive, Dropbox, OneDrive or WebDAV, for when {syncName} space runs out.
settings.about.line: Lingo {version} · English–Japanese dictionary: EJDict-hand (public domain) · Word forms and frequency data: Wiktionary (CC BY-SA)
dict.title: Dictionary
dict.notSavedNote: Not saved yet. Save it as Learning or Known and Lingo will remember where you see it next.
saveAll.note: Words you have already saved keep their status. Words inside the common-word level are not counted.
saveAll.cardNote: You can turn this card off in Settings.
endCard.region: Save the rest of this page
video.subtitle: Subtitle
video.toggle.on: Lingo is on — click to turn off
video.toggle.off: Lingo is off — click to turn on
